title: Pelican Charter Tres Idiomas
style: trilingual coastal indie folk, gentle acoustic guitar, brushed drums, warm upright bass, soft accordion swells, ocean ambience, NZ AU vocal lean, 92 bpm, three-language verse handoff, communal chorus harmonies
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Pelican on the charter, wings wide and slow
Swan River shining where the easy waters go
Pete on the helm, Brandon tuned it tight
Rotto on the horizon, Tuesday in the light

[Verse 2 — Español]
Pelícano en el barco, alas en el viento
Río de los cisnes, todo en su momento
Pete al timón, Brandon afina el tono
Rotto nos espera, martes en el trono

[Verse 3 — 中文]
鹈鹕 zài chuán shàng, fēng qīng làng màn
Tiān é hé liú jīng, shí jiān bù huāng
Pete zhǎng duò, Brandon tiáo yīn
Rotto zài qián fāng, xīng qī èr jiàn

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Three tongues, one boat, one keel
Tres lenguas, un barco, real
三种语言，一艘船，真实
We sail, navegamos, wǒmen háng

[Bridge]
No machines between us, human to human
Sin máquinas entre nosotros, humano
人 dào 人, méi yǒu jī qì
The charter holds, el contrato vive, hé yuē huó

[Outro]
See you on Tuesday, nos vemos el martes, xīng qī èr jiàn
Pelican charter forever, para siempre, yǒng yuǎn
